about_the_game:
A set of valuable items the player character can use to raise his/her stats.

Life Droplet x10
Power Droplet x10
Defense Droplet x10
Magic Droplet x10
Spirit Droplet x10

*Can also be obtained in-game.
*Open [DLC] under [Item] page in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*Please note that all items in excess of the maximum amount will be lost.
*Sora no Kiseki the 1st base game (sold separately) required to access this content. Please update and install the most recent patch if necessary.
